results.post_full: 相比微信 更多东西我愿意放在微博里。恍惚间军训过去好几天了，今天上午休息的时候一中的同学们都在踢足球，可是我看着他们穿着红色的校服踢足球我突然想到初中了，想到我们初中的班足球赛的场面，眼泪一下就掉下来，也没人注意到我，我就悄悄地抹眼泪，后来看到了初中的同学，一下情绪就收不住了，哇哇地嚎，甚至我现在打字都在掉眼泪。红色的校服身上我看不到一点儿蓝色的影子，我真的太想太想初中了。我真的太难受了。我永远忘不了初中的球赛，忘不了那帮同学，忘不了我们在一起的三年，忘不了好朋友们在一起谈天说地的时刻，忘不了中考后班主任在我面前掉眼泪的画面。张老师，还有我亲爱的同学们，我真的好想好想你们啊。一中的老师同学都很好，可是我找不到初中的感觉了，我甚至觉得孤独，还有一种说不出来的无助，好像你们终将要离我而去。我好想十七班。
results.translation: Compared to WeChat, I prefer to share more things on Weibo. It feels like military training ended days ago. During the break this morning, students from No. 1 High School were playing soccer, but when I saw them wearing red uniforms, I suddenly thought of middle school—the scene of our class soccer match in junior high. Tears immediately fell, and no one noticed me, so I quietly wiped them away. Later, I saw a classmate from junior high and couldn't hold back my emotions anymore, crying loudly. Even now, as I type, tears are falling. In the red uniforms, I can't see a trace of blue. I miss junior high so, so much. I'm really heartbroken. I'll never forget the soccer matches in junior high, those classmates, the three years we spent together, the moments chatting and laughing with good friends, and the sight of our homeroom teacher crying in front of me after the high school entrance exam. Teacher Zhang, and my dear classmates, I miss you all so, so much. The teachers and students at No. 1 High School are great, but I can't find the feeling of junior high anymore. I even feel lonely and an indescribable helplessness, as if you are all eventually going to leave me. I miss Class 17 so much.
results.exp4_justification: The post expresses deep feelings of sadness and longing for the past, with phrases like "我真的太难受了" (I really feel too bad) and "我甚至觉得孤独" (I even feel lonely). The author reflects on lost connections and a sense of helplessness, indicating persistent emotional distress.
